name: web-researcher-mcp
description: Search the web and primary sources, read full pages, verify citations. Runs on your machine. Web search, full-page reading, academic, patent, legal, filings and economic research, and a trust suite that catches fabricated, retracted or mischaracterized citations. Zero-config with DuckDuckGo; connect Brave, Serper, Tavily, Exa or others for richer results.
